description: This file defines the HttpKernel class extending Symfony's BaseHttpKernel, responsible for initializing and configuring the application's HTTP handling, including setting up services, routing, logging, and session management for the OrangeHRM installer platform.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: Extends Symfony's BaseHttpKernel to provide application-specific configurations, including service setup, routing, logging, and session management tailored for the OrangeHRM installer environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HttpKernel with environment and debug settings, configures services, and logger.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Registers core services into the service container.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Sets up the logging mechanism, determining log file path and level, and adds subscribers.

methods.name: isLogFileWritable
methods.description: Checks if the log file is writable by attempting to append a dummy line.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Sets up the routing system and request context.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Loads route definitions from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures the session storage based on write permissions.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates and initializes the session object with appropriate options.

methods.name: configureSubscribers
methods.description: Registers event subscribers such as exception handling.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Prepares and handles an HTTP request, returning a response.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Returns whether debug mode is active.
